Our equestrian world

Every horse.
Every possibility.

At our haras in Belgium, good horsemanship begins with understanding the individual. From foals and young horses to sport horses, our approach combines professional training with daily, attentive care.

01 / Care & boarding

A place to thrive.

Horse pension in a peaceful setting, with daily supervision and space for every stage of life.

  • Boarding for young and retired horses
  • Broodmare care and foaling supervision
  • Shared boxes and time in the fields
  • Coordination of hoof care and routine health needs
Enquire about boarding

02 / Training & development

Potential, patiently developed.

Professional young horse training, from breaking in to confident work in the arena.

  • Individual training in show jumping and dressage
  • Full-time training and competition preparation
  • Professional equestrian facilities
  • Lessons with your own horse
Talk to us about your horse
Explore our facilities

A PROGRAMME FOR EVERY STAGE

Four stages.
One philosophy.

Time, patience and a programme shaped around the individual horse.

Our approach on Instagram
01Foal handling

Gentle first contact, confident handling and positive habits for everyday care. Building trust from the beginning.

02Pre-breaking

Preparing the young horse for its future under saddle, step by step. Nothing rushed; each stage follows the horse’s readiness.

03Breaking in

From the first mounting to calm, balanced ridden work. The pace is adapted to age, maturity and temperament.

04Show jumping training

Individual work towards development, performance and competition preparation, with regular progress reviews and close communication with the owner.
